newsitem.title: USA: Avista is new name for Washington Water unit.
newsitem.headline: Avista is new name for Washington Water unit.

text.p: Washington Water Power Co said Monday Avista Advantage is the new name for the company's energy services and new product development subsidiary that had been doing business for the past 15 months as WWP Energy Solutions.
In February, Washington Water Power said, its board approved formation of Avista Corp, a wholly owned subsidiary. Avista Advantage is an operating company of Avista Corp.
The comapny also said Gerry D. Crooks has been named president and chief operating officer of Avista Advantage.
He was previously vice president of WWP Solutions.
In addition, the utility said Avista Advantage has opened an office in Las Vegas.

Crooks said Avista Advantage is increasingly being asked to work with customers in southern Nevada and throughout the Southwest. Further, an additional presence in this region will help position Avista Advantage in California energy markets, particularly when that market opens to customer choice.
"We have already established our company in this region through our agreement with SharePlus and its 565 member hospitals throughout California," Crooks said.
"With our increased activities in this area, we felt it was important to establish a physical presence in the region."
